CustomField.formula: IF(AND( Proposal__r.Qantas_Annual_Expenditure__c >= Proposal__r.Account__r.QF_Revenue__c, Proposal__r.Domestic_Annual_Share__c >= Proposal__r.Account__r.QF_Domestic_Market_Share__c, Proposal__r.International_Annual_Share__c >= Proposal__r.Account__r.QF_International_Market_Share__c ), 'Likely', IF(Proposal__r.Domestic_Annual_Share__c >= Proposal__r.Account__r.QF_Domestic_Market_Share__c , 'Moderate','Not Likely'))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Likely - meets all Revenue & Share Targets Moderate - meets DOM Share Target Not Likely - not meeting any Target
CustomField.label: Guided Likelihood to Pay
